title: You Can Stay in a Haunted 1883 Manor in St. Paul for Just Over $100 a Night
excerpt: A restored 1883 Victorian manor in St. Paul was named one of the most haunted Airbnbs in America by Parade. Rooms start just over $100 a night.
content:
If you're someone who really wants to get into the spooky part of spooky season, a stay at this Airbnb in St. Paul might be just for you. This place has been named one of the most haunted Airbnbs in the entire country by Parade.

So if you're hoping to have some ghostly interactions this Halloween, see if you can book a stay at The Manor Master Chamber.

ALSO READ: This Small Town in MN Might be the Most Haunted Place in the State

The Most Haunted Airbnb in Minnesota

This home in St. Paul is a restored Victorian-era manor, built in 1883. It was owned by the same family for generations, according to Parade.

Today, this home invites people for a stay and maybe a scare or two, depending on if you believe in ghosts. Regardless of if you believe in that stuff or if you experience anything, the home is decorated in a way that's perfect for spooky season with "antiques, oddities, and hand-crafted details in every room."

Home Named St. Paul's Most Mysterious House

Not only is this place allegedly haunted, it also was once named the most mysterious house in St. Paul. That's because of the decor that the host, Sean, has placed around the home.

Stay the Night in the Most Haunted Airbnb in Minnesota

You don't get the whole place to yourself during your stay (unless you can convince some friends to book the place with you) but you'll have one room and a shared bathroom for you to use.

The room that I'm looking at has a queen bed and costs just over $100 per night depending on when you stay.

Now, let's take a photo tour!

St. Paul Airbnb Named One of the Most Haunted in the US

Parade is out with the 10 most haunted Airbnbs for 2025. One of the Airbnbs on the list is in St. Paul, Minnesota called The Manor Master Chamber.
